name: adk-libpetri-diagrams
description: Renders the README diagrams: illustrative sketches built via the libpetri npm package (dot/sketch-*.dot), plus every DOT file in dot/ (including those exported by Java's ReadmeDiagramsTest and Python's tests/readme_diagrams), to SVG via graphviz.

scripts.render: mkdir -p svg && for f in dot/*.dot; do dot -Tsvg "$f" -o "svg/$(basename "$f" .dot).svg" || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run sketches && npm run render
